lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity that align with the vertical positioning of the spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a distinct horizontal gradient where the top edge is illuminated and the bottom edge is in shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin and the mid-lateral flank.
